beats.text: One harmless question predicts if your date wants sex on the first night.
Do you like the taste of beer?
Beer fans were sixty percent more likely to be okay sleeping with someone they just met. Men and women.
Want something long-term instead? Ask three things.
Do you like horror movies? Have you ever traveled alone to another country? Would it be fun to quit everything and live on a sailboat?
Thirty-two percent of long-term couples agreed on all three. Nearly four times chance.

sources: OkCupid (2011), 'The Best Questions For A First Date' (OkTrends). Liking the taste of beer: 60% more likely to be okay with sex with someone just met (both genders); horror movies / travel alone abroad / sailboat: 32% of long-term couples agreed on all three, 3.7x coincidence.
